wc:minerva-description-list.summary: Native description list of labeled fields.
wc:minerva-description-list.description: Labeled metadata fields as a native `<dl>` (`<DescriptionList>` of React). Each item is a row (`<div>`) holding one `<dt>` / `<dd>` pair; rows stack on narrow screens. Rows come from the `items` property and / or from `<minerva-description-item label="...">` children (rendered after the `items`). Each child is assigned into the `<dd>` of its row (manual slot assignment), so the native `<dl>` structure is kept.

properties.name: bordered
properties.description: Frames the list as a card (full border, rounded corners, surface background, padded rows)

properties.name: striped
properties.description: Tints every other row (replaces the row separators)

properties.name: items
properties.description: Rows rendered before the declarative `<minerva-description-item>` children
